title: Have Been Subscribing for Six Months
text:
They're good. The shirts fit as expected and are of good quality considering the cost of $19.99 in the year 2022: quite decent.
Designs are generally unique. Will update if anything changes.
Generally holiday themed. (September was Lucy pulling the football away from Charlie Brown; January was a winter scene). Characters highlighted thus far include Sally, Linus, Charlie, Lucy, Schroeder, Woodstock and Snoopy.
Just waiting on Franklin, Marcie, and Peppermint Patty for the whole official Peanuts Gang to be counted.

I love this t-shirt of the month club.
label: positive
